title: FilmCraft controls
summary: The buttons: boot the editor with its control channel open, serve the offline browser editor, stop either - plus the route and the record behind every one of them.

surfaces.usb: DEGRADED(the buttons refuse by name on a stick that carries no payload, and the fetcher is named; nothing is downloaded by a click)
surfaces.web: N/A(same steward decision as the other actuator cards: a browser tab cannot start a process on this machine)

notes: The actuator half of the film pair: `lygo.filminfo` reads the facts, and this module is where FilmCraft is actually started, served and stopped. It owns exactly one thing - `save/film`, this harness's own small state (the pid and port of what the console started, the cached command catalogue, the last run script) - written through atomicio behind the p0 gate. It renders nothing itself: every call goes through the `film` limb's own harness, declared here as owned (the limb lives in limbs.py and is not re-registered, so no tool changes behaviour and none is listed twice). WHAT IT WILL NOT DO: it will not stop an editor or a helper it did not start (a window the operator launched belongs to the operator, and `stop` refuses that case by name); it will not claim a process came up because it spawned one (the control port answering is the proof, and a boot that dies reports its log tail); it will not start a download - a stick with no payload refuses and names scripts/fetch_filmcraft.ps1; and it will not export over the operator's own project without consent (a project outside workspace/film is refused unless the caller passes consent).
